nodes.text:
And it has symptoms that could be anything, including the common cold…

‘HMPV typically causes symptoms similar to the common cold, including a cough, runny nose or nasal congestion, a sore throat and fever that clear after around five days.’

nodes.author: Russell4Heather
nodes.text: ‘Professor Jonathan Ball, a virologist at Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine, added: 'HPMV has been known about since 2001, and has been circulating in humans for at least 50 years - probably a lot longer.’

nodes.author: Russell4Heather
nodes.text: 'Unfortunately, it is associated with pneumonia, particularly in young children, but this is thankfully rare.'

nodes.author: Russell4Heather
nodes.text: ‘One of the issues involved in these types of infection is that they are being diagnosed more frequently, so it is not always easy to know whether, year-on-year, increases are due to actual increases or just because we are diagnosing a greater proportion of infections.'

nodes.author: Russell4Heather
nodes.text: This article received an honorable mention in today’s  Health Fear Porn Award category.  It’s a hot day in Fear Porn peddling.
